_doc: Story 4.3 GOLDEN FIXTURE — the ROT / grön-teknik DEDUCTION policy pin (4.3-GOLDEN-01 + 4.3-GOLDEN-02, R-405/R-406/R-407/R-408/R-410/R-411/R-412). Pins representative deduction cases: ROT at/above/below the per-person cap, grön-teknik per-category rates/caps, the eligible-basis boundaries (zero basis, hidden-row inclusion), the INVALID ROT×grön mix (asserts the BLOCKING error, never a silent combined sum), and BRF/private/company-like eligibility cases. The deduction rate ALWAYS flows in from the profile as a BASIS-POINT input (deductionPercentBp) — the engine invents NO rate and holds NO percent constant, so there is NO hidden 0.30/30/0.50/50/1.3 literal in the deduction path (R-404 generalized to tax rates, epic blocker). deductionOre = min( roundToOre(eligibleBasisOre * deductionPercentBp / 10000), capOre ) under the SINGLE Story 4.1 half-away-from-zero rounding mode; multi-line basis sums via sumOre (sum-of-rounded). The rates/caps below are CONSERVATIVE UNAPPROVED PLACEHOLDER PROFILES (ROT 30.00% = 3000 bp, per-person cap 5 000 000 öre = 50 000 kr; grön-teknik 20.00% = 2000 bp, per-category cap 5 000 000 öre) pending owner/accounting/legal sign-off (Sign-Off Q3/Q4/Q5/Q7, test-design-epic-4; owner-decisions 2026-06-18 'rates/caps/schablon still pending the working session'). They are recorded as ASSUMPTIONS, NOT accounting/legally-final; the engine warns and NEVER marks a tax output approved (R-405). If the dev pins DIFFERENT conservative numbers, update THIS fixture's expected values to match — the fixture is the numeric source of truth; a later sign-off swaps the numbers with NO code-shape change. Each case carries an `origin` label — `new-expected` (the pilot's explicit conservative assumption) or `documented-delta` (an intentional divergence from Lovable). Money/rate/cap numbers ONLY — NO PII (personnummer/orgnr/name/email/address), NO clock (NFR17/R-411/R-412). The engine takes a resolved eligibility POSTURE, NEVER a personnummer. STOP (needs-human) if the numeric rates/caps/eligibility/disclaimer MUST be treated as production-approved (the story stop condition).

policy.rounding: single Story 4.1 roundToOre (half-away-from-zero); multi-line basis via sumOre (sum-of-rounded)
policy.capBehavior: at cap -> deduction = cap; above cap -> CLAMPED to cap (a warning may note the clamp); below cap -> rate-applied amount
policy.mixRule: ROT and grön teknik CANNOT be mixed on one calculation -> BLOCKING ROT_GRON_MIX_NOT_ALLOWED failure (R-406), never a silent combined sum
policy.eligibility: ONLY a `private` posture is eligible (owner decision 2026-06-18); a non-private posture (company/brf/public) yields an eligibility warning or a blocking result
policy.personnummer: NOT captured or required by the pure engine — eligibility is a resolved POSTURE, never a personnummer (R-412)
policy.hiddenRowBasis: hidden rows DO count toward the eligible basis (owner decision 2026-06-18, Epic 5.4/5.5); Epic 4 pins the pure BASIS rule, UI visibility is Epic 5
policy.approval: NEVER approved by default — requiresSignOff:true is the structural default (R-405); constants are UNAPPROVED profiles pending owner/accounting/legal sign-off

ROT_PROFILE_UNAPPROVED._note: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — ROT 30.00% (3000 bp), per-person cap 50 000 kr (5 000 000 öre). Pending Sign-Off Q3 (per-person cap / % / labour-only basis / multi-owner). NOT production-approved.

GRON_TEKNIK_PROFILE_UNAPPROVED._note: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — grön-teknik 20.00% (2000 bp), per-category cap 50 000 kr (5 000 000 öre), schablon NOT modelled in the placeholder. Pending Sign-Off Q4 (category rates/caps/schablon/mix). NOT production-approved.

deductionCases.note: ROT below the per-person cap. eligibleBasis 100 000 öre (1 000,00 kr) @ 3000 bp = round(30000) = 30 000 öre; well under the 5 000 000 öre cap. Private posture -> eligible, no not-eligible warning. requiresSignOff true.

ROT exactly AT the per-person cap. eligibleBasis 16 666 667 öre @ 3000 bp = round(5000000.1) = 5 000 000 öre = the cap exactly -> deduction = cap. (16 666 667 * 3000 / 10000 = 5 000 000.1 -> rounds to 5 000 000.) At-cap -> deduction equals cap.

ROT ABOVE the per-person cap -> deduction CLAMPED to the cap; a warning may note the clamp. eligibleBasis 30 000 000 öre @ 3000 bp = 9 000 000 öre raw, exceeds the 5 000 000 öre cap -> clamped to 5 000 000. deduction never exceeds the cap.
Zero eligible basis -> deduction 0 (valid, NOT a rejection). eligibleBasis 0 @ 3000 bp = 0. Private posture eligible.

Half-away-from-zero rounding pin on the deduction path (mirrors the Story 4.1/4.2 golden). eligibleBasis 5 öre @ 3000 bp = 1.5 öre exactly -> round-half-away-from-zero -> 2 (banker's/half-to-even would give 2 as well here; the distinguishing .5 case is 15 öre @ 3000 = 4.5 -> 5, banker's would give 4). Uses 15 öre to distinguish the mode.
Grön teknik per-category, below cap. eligibleBasis 200 000 öre @ 2000 bp = round(40000) = 40 000 öre; under the 5 000 000 öre category cap. Private posture eligible. Own profile (not ROT's).

Grön teknik ABOVE the per-category cap -> clamped. eligibleBasis 30 000 000 öre @ 2000 bp = 6 000 000 öre raw, exceeds the 5 000 000 öre cap -> clamped to 5 000 000. A separate golden case from ROT so the grön category cap is pinned independently.

Hidden-row inclusion (R-408, owner decision 2026-06-18: hidden rows DO count in totals + deductions). Multi-line basis [60 000, 40 000] where the 2nd line is a 'hidden' row -> eligibleBasis = sumOre = 100 000 öre (hidden row INCLUDED). deduction 100 000 @ 3000 bp = 30 000. Epic 4 pins the pure BASIS rule; UI visibility is Epic 5.

eligibilityCases.note: PRIVATE posture -> eligible (owner decision 2026-06-18: only `private` is eligible for ROT/grön teknik). No not-eligible warning; the deduction computes normally. requiresSignOff still true.
COMPANY posture -> NOT eligible under the conservative Phase-A policy: an eligibility WARNING (or a blocking result). The customer-facing disclaimer wording is NOT shipped as legally-approved.
BRF (bostadsrättsförening) posture -> NOT eligible under the conservative Phase-A policy: an eligibility WARNING (or a blocking result). BRF handling is a Sign-Off Q5 assumption, not legally-final.
PUBLIC-sector posture -> NOT eligible under the conservative Phase-A policy: an eligibility WARNING (or a blocking result).

invalidMixCase.note: LOAD-BEARING mix block (R-406, epic blocker). A request combining ROT AND grön teknik on one calculation returns the BLOCKING ROT_GRON_MIX_NOT_ALLOWED typed failure — NEVER a silently-combined deduction sum. Owner decision 2026-06-18: 'ROT and grön teknik cannot be mixed'. There is NO combined-sum code path. The expected result is a typed FAILURE, not a deductionOre.
